client_id.title: DB BahnPark client ID
client_id.description: The client ID of a DB API Marketplace application subscribed to Parking Information (DB BahnPark).

steps: Register/log in to the DB API Marketplace via 'DB Kundenkonto'.
Create an application with 'Neue Anwendung erstellen'.
In the Katalog, open 'Parking Information Service - DB BahnPark' and subscribe the free Testzugang plan.
Open the application's details and copy its Client ID into this field.
setup.cost: Free: Testzugang allows up to 1,000 transactions/month (max 10 req/min), no approval.
setup.notes: Provides ~315 DB BahnPark facilities. The higher transit-authority plan needs a separate data agreement.

api_key.title: DB BahnPark API key
api_key.description: The client secret of the same DB API Marketplace application.

steps: Register/log in to the DB API Marketplace and create an application ('Neue Anwendung erstellen').
Copy the Client Secret (API key) shown once during application creation.
Subscribe ('Abonnieren') the 'Parking Information Service - DB BahnPark' Testzugang plan to that application.
Paste the Client Secret here (sent as the DB-Api-Key header).
setup.cost: Free: Testzugang allows up to 1,000 transactions/month (max 10 req/min), no approval.
setup.notes: The Client Secret is displayed only once at creation; regenerate it in the application settings if lost.

feeds.attribution: Parking Information Daten der DB BahnPark – API über den DB API Marketplace (https://developers.deutschebahn.com/db-api-marketplace/apis/product/parking-information-db-bahnpark)

username.title: NE Travel Data username
username.description: The username of a netraveldata.co.uk account; the website login is the API credential.

steps: Go to the UTMC Open Data Service (NE Travel Data) at netraveldata.co.uk and register a free account via the 'Register' link.
Confirm your registration email and set a password.
Use the username you signed up with as this value — the same site account credentials authenticate the API feeds.
setup.notes: This is the Newcastle / Tyne & Wear (UTMC) feed at netraveldata.co.uk — not a Glasgow contact. The website login you create is the API credential.

email.subject: API access request — UTMC Open Data Service (car park feed)
email.body:
Hello,

I would like to access the UTMC / NE Travel Data open-data API, in particular the car park occupancy feeds for Tyne & Wear / Newcastle.

I have registered an account on netraveldata.co.uk; could you please confirm that my account credentials are enabled for API access, or advise if any additional registration step is required?

Intended use: integrating live car-park availability into an open-source mapping application.

Thank you,
[Your name]

password.title: NE Travel Data password
password.description: The password of the same netraveldata.co.uk account.

steps: During registration on netraveldata.co.uk, set (or reset) the password for your account.
Use that account password as this value.
The username + password pair is sent as HTTP credentials when fetching the UTMC car-park feed.
setup.notes: Same netraveldata.co.uk account as the UTMC username — there is no separate API password; the website login doubles as the API credential.

feeds.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (North East UTMC / Newcastle City Council)

api_key.title: Transport for NSW Open Data API key (Australia)
api_key.description: An Open Data Hub API token, sent as the 'apikey' authorization header. Serves the Live Traffic hazards, the Park&Ride car parks and the Live Traffic cameras.

steps: Register for a free account at opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au and log in to the Open Data Hub.
Click your profile icon, choose 'API Tokens', enter a name, click 'CREATE API TOKEN' and copy the key (shown only once).
In the data catalogue, open the 'Car park API' and 'Live Traffic Cameras API' datasets and subscribe each to your application; the token alone authorises the live-hazard endpoints.
Paste the generated token here (sent as the 'apikey' authorization header).
setup.notes: CC-BY-4.0; attribution "Transport for NSW". One token for the hazards, car-park and camera feeds.

url.title: Overpass URL
url.description: Base URL of the Overpass instance (http://overpass:80, https://overpass-api.de) or its full interpreter URL (http://overpass:80/api/interpreter), as OpenMapX's OVERPASS_URL accepts: queries go to the base URL plus /api/interpreter. Defaults to the public instance, which allows about 10,000 requests a day; point it at a self-hosted Overpass for heavier use. A private host also needs OPENCONDITIONS_EGRESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
